thread:
samir patel: quickn: we need a concrete default for the continuous-batcher UX. two camps: express-first (short wait, speculative small batches) vs dense-first (longer coalesce, high batch density). microbursts make this painful.
zoe chen: i favor dense by default. most tenants prioritize cost and stable kv-cache behavior. express should be opt-in per-route.
greg hansen: counterpoint: product interactive routes suffer high p95 with dense. express can cut p95 but increases gpu_seconds and kv churn. idea: hybrid runtime mapping from two simple knobs: latency_target_ms and cost_priority (low/med/high).
samir patel: example mapping sketch:
```
if latency_target_ms <= 120 -> route.mode = express
else -> route.mode = dense
route.cost_priority = {low,med,high}
```
express bounded by speculative_token_budget_per_minute and decay.
zoe chen: binding to two knobs is nice. operational guard: auto-disable express if kv_miss_rate delta > 8% for 5m or speculative_tokens_used > budget*1.2.
infra-bot: ALERT: canary-17: batcher.kv_miss_rate increased 9% in 6m
greg hansen: that alert lines up with express=true on canary-17. p95 improved but throughput dipped. confirms kv churn tradeoff.
samir patel: operational recommendations: 1) soft_min_batch + hysteresis instead of hard min. 2) priority_score for speculative requests so they can join existing coalesced batches if present.
zoe chen: soft_min idea: soft_min=4, soft_window_ms=25, decay_ms=180. priority_score range 0.0-1.0 where express starts 0.9 and decays as wait_time grows.
greg hansen: telemetry we need: per-route batch_size_histogram, wait_time_p95, kv_hit_ratio_delta, speculative_tokens_consumed, gpu_seconds_per_token. these let auto-disable rules be safe.
samir patel: action items: i'll draft an RFC with mapping table + auto-disable thresholds + canary plan. greg: add simulator replay script for microburst traces. zoe: mock Console controls (latency_target, cost_priority, force-mode toggle). timeline: RFC draft Mon EOD, review Tue.
greg hansen: will run sims Wed and paste results.
zoe chen: will mock toggle + small dashboard tile (batch_size vs kv_miss) by Tue.
infra-bot: NOTE: deploy-bot: rolled canary-17 express=true at 1729997000
samir patel: one more thought: surface a "route.health" signal derived from the telemetry so Console can show auto-disable reason (e.g., kv_miss spike). keeps users from guessing.
greg hansen: love that. ok closing until RFC posted. :thumbsup:
